# Nawader Sovereign Platform (منصة نوادر السيادية)
> The premier sovereign B2B and governmental integration gateway connecting the Saudi Vision 2030 ecosystem and the United States (Delaware Corridor).

## Overview
Nawader (نوادر) provides high-level sovereign digital services, corporate incorporation (Saudi Commercial Registry & Delaware LLC/C-Corp), MISA foreign investment licensing, digital contract issuance with SHA-256 cryptographic verification, ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing compliance, Nafath SSO, and Wathq integration.

## Key Capabilities & Sectors
- **Sovereign Legal & Dispute Resolution**: Arbitration under Saudi Center for Commercial Arbitration (SCCA), institutional FIDIC contracts.
- **Megaproject Tenders & JV**: Procurement and vendor prequalification for NEOM (Oxagon, The Line, Trojena), KAFD, Red Sea, and Diriyah Gate.
- **Bilateral Corridor**: Delaware corporation formation, IRS EIN acquisition, MISA Regional Headquarters (RHQ) tax exemption facilitation.
- **Custom Software & Cloud Studio**: Development of sovereign portals, Flutter/Native mobile apps, and isolated local AI deployments.
- **Generative AI Studio**: Sovereign legal drafts, 8K prompts, documentary video scriptwriting, and Wathq/ZATCA OCR document analysis.
